Participants with previously treated brain metastases are eligible to participate if:

   * they are neurologically and radiologically stable for at least 28 days prior to the first dose of 177Lu-BetaBart; and
   * have no history of leptomeningeal disease or spinal cord compression.

Must have at least 1 measurable target lesion according to RECIST v1.1.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2
Any other known, active malignancy, except for treated cervical intraepithelial neoplasia, or non-melanoma skin cancer.
Participants who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Known active hepatitis B or known active hepatitis C infection.
Active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment within 90 days.
